Command
On Immobilizing an enemy champion, mark them as 7% Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

(no row exists for damage-amplification composition; the document is silent on how distinct increased-damage-taken multipliers combine, so the composition rule was derived from the item texts themselves)

independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_two_amplifiers: The scenario name names both items. Cached wiki text gives two debuffs on the TARGET, each phrased as increased damage taken 'from all sources': Imperial Mandate 'Vulnerable' = +7% damage taken (all damage types), Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' curse = +12% magic damage taken.
independent_computation.step_2_who_benefits: Both are target-side debuffs applied by an aura/mark, worded 'from all sources' -- not 'from you'. In a coupled ROSTER scenario (multiple participants on one team) the Abyssal Mask holder need not be the damage dealer: any allied champion's magic damage on a cursed target is amplified. An engine that only amplified the holder's own damage would omit the 12% entirely for a teammate's magic event.
independent_computation.step_3_composition_rule: Two distinct debuffs, each an independent multiplier on damage taken, with no cached text stating additive stacking between separate amplification sources. Independent multipliers on the same quantity compose multiplicatively: taken = raw * (1 + 0.07) * (1 + 0.12).

step_4_arithmetic.interpretation: The new value equals the old value times exactly the Abyssal Mask Unmake factor (1.12). The change is that the Abyssal curse, previously absent from this event, is now applied -- multiplicatively, on top of whatever amplification the event already carried.
step_4_arithmetic.additive_alternative_excluded: If the two amps were meant to stack ADDITIVELY and the old value carried only Mandate's 7% (base = 419.2/1.07 = 391.7757), the additive answer would be 391.7757 * 1.19 = 466.2, NOT 469.5. The multiplicative answer is 391.7757 * 1.07 * 1.12 = 469.5. The golden's new value therefore encodes multiplicative composition, which matches the item wording (two separate 'damage taken' multipliers, neither declaring additive stacking).
step_4_arithmetic.old_value_diagnosis: 419.2 = 469.504 / 1.12 -- i.e. the pre-change number is exactly the post-change number with the Abyssal Mask curse dropped. Under the cached wiki text, a magic-damage event against a target standing inside an allied Abyssal Mask's 700-unit curse MUST carry the 12%; the old value is short by exactly that factor.

confidence_and_limits: The golden scenario's input tuple (attacker, level, loadouts, target resistances, which roster member holds which item, event[3]'s damage type) is defined outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/ and tests/ are off limits, and data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no Abyssal/Mandate scenario). I therefore could not reconstruct the ABSOLUTE damage from first principles.

What is independently verifiable from data/ alone is the DELTA, and it is a clean fingerprint: the change is exactly one factor of 1.12 -- the Abyssal Mask Unmake multiplier as cached -- applied multiplicatively. Nothing else in data/items.json carries a 12% magic-damage-taken amplifier, so the delta is uniquely attributable.

Residual assumption: event[3] is a MAGIC-damage event and the cursed target is within the aura in this scenario. If event[3] were physical/true damage, Unmake would not apply and 419.2 would stand. The scenario is named for exactly this interaction and the delta is exactly Unmake's factor, which makes the magic-damage reading overwhelmingly likely but not provable from data/ alone.
verdict_rationale: The new value applies the Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' curse (+12% magic damage taken, 'from all sources', cached wiki text) multiplicatively, which is what the item text requires for a coupled roster where an ally carries the mask. The old value omitted that factor entirely (419.2 * 1.12 = 469.5 to the digit). The additive-composition alternative (466.2) is excluded by the observed number.
